name: Barbell Spider Curl
steps: Set an adjustable bench to roughly a 45-degree incline and lie chest-down with your feet braced behind you.
Grasp a barbell shoulder-width apart with palms facing forward and let your arms hang straight vertically.
Curl the bar smoothly upward toward your shoulders while keeping your upper arms perpendicular to the floor.
Pause briefly at the top contraction, then lower the bar slowly back to full extension.
tips: Keep your chest pressed against the bench and prevent your shoulders from rolling forward.
Avoid pulling your elbows backward toward your ribs as you curl up.
